verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://posthog.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a PostHog summary, and the docs are served as per-page markdown (.md URLs). Agent-oriented material goes further: downloadable SKILL.md bundles (skills.zip, confirmed live), an AI plugin that bundles every skill, a CLI installer that adds instructions to your coding agent, and a live OpenAPI spec. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents actually consuming llms.txt or the .md docs, and a root docs.md index (that probe returned 404).
